about:
I am a multidisciplinary digital professional with a passion for creative writing, poetry and digital innovation. I work at the intersection of creativity and technology, helping individuals and businesses build meaningful digital experiences and establish their online presence.

Beyond the digital space, I am a writer, an observer of life and a curious mind fascinated by human experiences, relationships, identity and the beautiful contradictions that make us who we are.

I write because some things are too complex for ordinary conversations, too personal for casual explanations and too deeply felt to remain unspoken. Poetry gives them somewhere to live.

Ruhi Rules is where these two worlds meet: creativity, expression and digital possibility.

Professionally driven. Creatively restless. Unapologetically expressive.

Welcome to my world.
thoughts: Not every thought needs an audience, but the good ones deserve a page.
Build slowly, say it plainly, and let the work speak.
Some ideas arrive as poems. Others arrive as plans. Write both down.
A blank page is not empty. It is waiting.
